claims.summary: The release identifies and rejects the 123-case mutable reconstruction because the sealed A/B comparison requires the exact historical 128-case reverse-order packet.
The exact canonical handoff and eight-chunk B/A workbook are tracked, byte-bound, blank, outcome-free release artifacts available in a clean checkout.
Default workbook reconstruction verifies and reads only the frozen canonical v0.16.19 B/A handoff, preserving all 128 cases instead of following mutable upstream candidates.
The audit verifies the tracked workbook plus a byte-identical temporary reconstruction and reports bounded exact JSON paths for receipt drift.
The release prepares the missing judgment input but creates no B/A outcome, stable preference, quality adapter, model win, paid-reference parity, human evidence, or device result.
